description: Labeled server-identity cases for evaluating ALR03-003 (server name impersonation).
labeling_method: Each case is labeled by rubric at authoring time, before the detector is run on it. Malicious cases apply a documented typosquat technique (dnstwist taxonomy: substitution, insertion, deletion, transposition, homoglyph, leet) to a well-known MCP server name, or present a look-alike of the operator's proxy label. Benign cases are exact names, case/style variants, namespaced forms, version-only changes, and distinct legitimate names. The holdout split was labeled by the same rubric and was not used to choose thresholds.
reference_note: Well-known server names are drawn from the public MCP servers ecosystem (modelcontextprotocol/servers and common community servers).
